card.name: Punctuation inside unfinished numbers
card.fires_on: A comma, hyphen, period or 'and' that comes right after a partial number of 1 to 3 digits, such as a year or page that is cut off. The number is expected to continue with more digits.

modes.label: Comma after cut-off year
modes.description: A comma follows a partial year, and the next number is a list item or the rest of a date.

modes.label: Hyphen in a range
modes.description: A hyphen follows a partial year or page number in a citation range.

modes.label: Decimal point or 'and' after a number
modes.description: A period or 'and' follows a partial number in coordinates or in a year range.

card.plain: It fires when a punctuation mark lands in the middle of a number, such as a year or page range that is cut short.
